segments.iti57:2.3: Kāmāsavo, bhavāsavo, avijjāsavo – ime kho, bhikkhave, tayo āsavā”ti.
segments.iti57:3.5: Dhāreti antimaṃ dehaṃ, jetvā māraṃ savāhinin”ti [savāhananti (bahūsu)].
segments.iti57:4.1: Ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā, iti me sutanti.

lines: 56-57. Sattame kāmāsavoti kāmesu āsavo, kāmasaṅkhāto vā āsavo kāmāsavo, atthato pana kāmarāgo rūpādiabhirati ca kāmāsavo.
Rūpārūpabhavesu chandarāgo jhānanikanti sassatadiṭṭhisahagato rāgo bhavapatthanā ca bhavāsavo.
Āsavānañca sambhavanti ettha ayonisomanasikāro avijjādayo ca kilesā āsavānaṃ sambhavo.
“Ayoniso, bhikkhave, manasikaroto anuppannā ceva āsavā uppajjanti, uppannā ca āsavā pavaḍḍhantī”ti (ma. ni.1.15).
“Avijjā, bhikkhave, pubbaṅgamā akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā anvadeva ahirikaṃ anottappan”ti (itivu.40) ca.
Tattha kāmāsavo anāgāmimaggena pahīyati, bhavāsavo avijjāsavo ca arahattamaggena.
Kāmupādānaṃ viya kāmāsavopi aggamaggavajjhoti ca vadanti.
